entries.title: James 1:1
segments: James, a servant of God and of [the] Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes in the Dispersion, greeting:

entries.title: James 1:2
segments: My brothers, count [it] all joy when you fall into different kinds of temptations,

entries.title: James 1:3
segments: knowing that the trying of your faith works patience.

entries.title: James 1:4
segments: But let patience have its perfect work, so that you may be perfect and entire, lacking nothing.

entries.title: James 1:5
segments: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, [who] gives to all liberally and with no reproach, and it shall be given to him.

entries.title: James 1:6
segments: But let him ask in faith, doubting nothing. For he who doubts is like a wave of [the] sea, driven by the wind and tossed.

entries.title: James 1:7
segments: For do not let that man think that he shall receive anything from the Lord;

entries.title: James 1:8
segments: [he is] a double-minded man, not dependable in all his ways.

entries.title: James 1:9
segments: But let [the] humble brother rejoice in his exaltation;

entries.title: James 1:10
segments: and the rich one [rejoice] in his humiliation, because he shall pass away as the flower of the grass.

entries.title: James 1:11
segments: For the sun rose with the hot wind and dried up the grass, and its flower fell out, and the beauty of its appearance perished; so also the rich one will fade away in his ways.

entries.title: James 1:12
segments: Blessed [is] the man who endures temptation, because having been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord has promised to those who love Him.

entries.title: James 1:13
segments: Let no one being tempted say, I am tempted from God. For God is not tempted by evils, and He tempts no one.

entries.title: James 1:14
segments: But each one is tempted by his lusts, being drawn away and seduced [by them].

entries.title: James 1:15
segments: Then when lust has conceived, [it] brings forth sin. And sin, when it is fully formed, brings forth death.

entries.title: James 1:16
segments: Do not err, my beloved brothers.

entries.title: James 1:17
segments: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above and comes down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness nor shadow of turning.

entries.title: James 1:18
segments: Of [His own] will He brought us forth with [the] Word of truth, for us to be a certain firstfruit of His creatures.

entries.title: James 1:19
segments: Therefore, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath.

entries.title: James 1:20
segments: For the wrath of man does not work out [the] righteousness of God.

entries.title: James 1:21
segments: Therefore putting aside all filthiness and overflowing of evil, receive in meekness the implanted Word, which is able to save your souls.

entries.title: James 1:22
segments: But become doers of the Word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

entries.title: James 1:23
segments: For if anyone is a hearer of [the] Word and not a doer, he is like a man studying his natural face in a mirror.

entries.title: James 1:24
segments: For he studied himself and went his way, and immediately [he] forgot what he was like.

entries.title: James 1:25
segments: But whoever looks into the perfect law of liberty and continues [in it], he is not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of [the] work. This one shall be blessed in his doing.

entries.title: James 1:26
segments: If anyone thinks to be religious among you, [yet] does not bridle his tongue, but deceives his own heart, this one's religion [is] vain.

entries.title: James 1:27
segments: Pure religion and undefiled before God and [the] Father [is] this, to visit orphans and widows in their afflictions, and to keep oneself unspotted from the world.
